target.title: ci(release): deduplicate Telegram routing proofs
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The beta Telegram live lane passed, but post-success diagnostic capture failed because ten credential-specific temp configs produced ten proof files while the trusted artifact contract caps the set at eight.

Failure: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29202979626

## Why This Change Was Made

Name each already-redacted, bounded routing proof by its content hash instead of the temporary config path hash. Credential-only config differences now converge on one proof file; genuinely distinct routing projections remain distinct and continue through the existing schema/size/mode validation.

The root maintainer note also makes non-main merge guards fail closed by requiring `set -euo pipefail` before assertion commands.

## User Impact

Successful beta Telegram release validation no longer fails only because a large credential pool emits duplicate diagnostic proofs. Failed lanes retain their strict proof requirements.

## Evidence

- Exact failed run: live lane `success`; capture failed with 10 valid proof files against the 8-file cap.
- Downloaded artifact contained nine identical bounded proofs and one distinct routing proof.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxbt135wck2rgmsw9gk2xyzn`: workflow contract suite 20/20.
- Targeted oxfmt and `git diff --check`: clean.
- Fresh autoreview: no findings, patch correct at 0.95 confidence.

After landing, rerun the preserved beta candidate `3db16088fc37033420742567dd6014b878672853` through Telegram QA.
